Offer for Buy-back of Equity Shares from Open Market through Stock Exchanges: The Board of Directors of the Target Company (the Board of Directors of the Company hereinafter referred to as the "Board of Directors"), in accordance with the authorization by the Articles of Association of the Company (the "AoA") and pursuant to the resolution passed by it (the "Board Resolution") at its meeting held on August 30, 2013 (the "Board Meeting"), approved the buy-back of the Company's fully paid-up equity shares of face value of Re.1/- each (the "Equity Shares") from its existing shareholders, other than those who are promoters, members of the promoter group, persons in control and persons acting in concert (such shareholders hereinafter referred to collectively as "Persons in Control") (it being understood that the "promoter", "promoter group", "persons in control" and "persons acting in concert" will be such persons as have been disclosed under the filings made by the Company under the listing agreement and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, as amended (the 'Takeover Regulations"), from the open market through stock exchanges for a total consideration not exceeding Rs.1,000 crores (the "Maximum Buy-Back Size"), and at a price not exceeding Rs.261/- per Equity Share (the "Maximum Buy-Back Price"), payable in cash (the process being referred hereinafter as "Buy-Back"). The Maximum Buy-Back Size and Maximum Buy-Back Price does not include brokerage costs, Securities and Exchange Board of India ("SEBI") turnover charges, taxes such as securities transaction tax, service tax and relevant stamp duty (collectively referred to as "Transaction Costs"). At the Maximum Buy-Back Price of Rs.261/- per Equity Share and for the Maximum Buy-Back Size of Rs.1,000 crores, the indicative maximum number of Equity Shares that can be bought back would be 38,314,176 Equity Shares (the "Maximum Buy-Back Shares"). If the Equity Shares are bought back at a price below the Maximum Buy-Back Price, the number of Equity Shares bought back could exceed the Maximum Buy-Back Shares, but will always be subject to the Maximum Buy-Back Size. An amount of Rs. 500 crores is the minimum Buy-Back size (the "Minimum Buy-Back Size") which is 50% of the Maximum Buy-Back Size. At the Maximum Buy-Back Price of Rs.261/- per Equity Share and for the Minimum Buy-Back Size of Rs.500 crores, the indicative maximum number of Equity Shares that can be bought back would be 19,157,089 Equity Shares. The Buy-Back will be implemented by the Company through the methodology of open market purchases through stock exchanges using the electronic trading facilities of the BSE Limited ("BSE") and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited ("NSE"), (hereinafter together referred to as the "Stock Exchanges").  Proposed Timetable:  Date of Board Resolution approving the Buy-Back - August 30, 2013;  Date of publication of the Announcement - September 06, 2013;  Date of opening of the Buy-Back - September 16, 2013;  Extinguishment of Equity Shares - The Equity Shares bought back and accepted during a month will be extinguished within 15 days of the succeeding month, provided that the Company shall ensure that all the Equity Shares bought back are extinguished within 7 days of the last day of completion of the Buy-Back;  Last Date for the completion of Buy-Back - The earlier of: (i) March 15, 2014, i.e. 6 months from the date of the opening of the Buy-Back; or (ii) when the Maximum Buy-Back Size of Rs.1,000 crores has been utilised; or (iii) Such date as may be determined by the Board of Directors or a duly authorised committee thereof, in the event the Minimum Buy-Back Size of Rs.500 crores has been utilised in the Buy-Back, even if the Maximum Buy-Back Size has not been utilised or the indicative Maximum Buy-Back Shares have not been bought back (by giving appropriate notice of such earlier date).

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. had informed the Exchange that the BODs of the Company has, among others decided to set up additional 4 rotary kilns of 1,80,000 MT each, for manufacturing Sponge Iron, 50 MW (2X25 MW) Power Plant, Steel Melting Shop (SMS) with an annual capacity of 7,50,000 MTs in Raigarh (Chattisgarh) in two phases. The company has now informed that all the four Rotary Kilns, 50 MW (2 x 25MW) Power Plant and Steel Melting Shop (SMS) have been completed earlier than their scheduled dates of completion as given below: : 1] First Phase:- a) First Kiln, Capacity-1,80,000 MT, Scheduled date of completion-March 31, 2005, Actual Date of completion- September 30, 2004, Earlier completion by 6 months.  b) Second Kiln, Capacity-1,80,000 MT, Scheduled date of completion-March 31, 2005, Actual Date of completion-January 31, 2005, Earlier completion by 2 months. c) Power Plant, Capacity-25 MW, Scheduled date of completion- March 31, 2005, Actual Date of completion-September 30, 2004, Earlier completion by 6 months. d) Coal Washery, Capacity-35,00,000 MT, Scheduled date of completion-March 31, 2005, Actual Date of completion-March 31, 2005. 2) Second Phase:- a) Third Kiln, Capacity- 1,80,000 MT, Scheduled date of completion-September 30, 2005, Actual date of completion-March 31, 2005, Earlier completion by 6 months. b) Fourth Kiln, Capacity-1,80,000 MT, Scheduled date of completion- September 30, 2005, Actual Date of completion-March 31, 2005, Earlier completion by 6 months. c) Power Plant, Capacity-25 MW, Scheduled date of completion-September 30, 2005, Actual Date of completion- March 31, 2005, Earlier completion by 6 months. d) SMS Capacity- 7,50,000 MT, Scheduled date of completion-September 30, 2005, Actual Date of completion-March 31, 2005, Earlier completion by 6 months.

The company has further informed that this has resulted in enhancement of the capacities, the details of which are given below:-a) Product: Sponge Iron, Annual capacity before enhancement: 6,50,000 MT, Annual capacity after enhancement: 13,70,000 MT ;b)Product: Power, Annual capacity before enhancement: 215 MW, Annual capacity after enhancement: 265 MW ;c) Product: Steel Melting, Annual capacity before enhancement: 4,00,000 MT, Annual capacity after enhancement: 11,50,000 MT. It will take about 3 months for these new facilities to reach their optimum level of production.

The result of the Postal Ballot was declared on March 12, 2005 at the registered office of the Company.

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the Board has, at its meeting held on January 27, 2005, taken, among other things, decision for expansion/setting up of new facilities at Raigarh (Chhattisgarh) as given below: 1)To increase the capacity of steel Melting Shop (SMS) from 7.5 lac MTPA to 12.50 lacs MTPA at an estimated cost of Rs.150 crores. This expansion is scheduled to be completed by December 2005. 2)To expand and upgrade exiting Rail and Structural Mill from existing capacity of 7.50 lacs MTPA to 12.50 lacs MTPA at an estimated cost of Rs.350 crores. Expansion is scheduled to be completed by February 2007. 3)To set up another 75 MW capacity power plant based on flue gases of Coke oven and additional 150 tons steam generation capacity by CFBC boilers using washery middlings to run turbo boilers for blast furnace. These facilities will be set up at an estimated cost of Rs.400 crores and scheduled to be commissioned by September 2006. 4)To Set up of a Plate Mill with a capacity of 10.00 lacs MTPA at an estimated cost of Rs.550 crores. The mill is scheduled to be commissioned by March 2007.

The details of the press release shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the Company has signed Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Government of Chhattisgarh on January 07, 2005 for setting up clean-type Coke Oven, Sinter plant, Blast Furnace, Steel Melting Shop, Plate Mill, Rolling mill for manufacturing Rebar, TMT and Wire Rod, Power Plant and other utilities and associated facilities at Raigarh in the State of Chhattisgarh. The total cost of these facilities will be Rs.2595 crores. Under this MOU, the state Government of Chhattisgarh will, among other things, provide all necessary help in seeking clearances, approvals, permissions from state / Central Government Departments / agencies for implementation of these projects.

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission(CERC) has issued Power Trading License to the Company for Inter state trading of electricity as category 'A' electricity trader. By virtue of the license the company can trade Power in whole of India except in the state of Jammu & Kashmir. This has opened another area of business for the company which is already in power generation.

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the Jindal Power Ltd. has paid another advance of Rs.78.03Cr to Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) for supply of Boiler Turbine Generator Packages(BTGPs)for the second 500 MW Power Project. With this payment Jindal Power Ltd. has now paid advance to BHEL for supply, erection and commissioning of BTGPs for 1000 MW Power project being set up in Raigarh in state of Chhattigarh. The total project is likely to be commissioned by March,2008.

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the Board has at its meeting held on October 27, 2004, approved payment of interim dividend at the rate of 100% i.e. Rs.5/- per equity share of Rs.5/- each in respect of paid up equity share capital.

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the Company has signed Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Government of Orissa on October 18, 2004 for setting up 2.0 million MTPA steel plant, 80,000 MTPA Ferro Alloys Plant and 200 MW captive power plant in District Keonjhar of Orissa with an estimated investment of Rs.3,850 crores (Rs.38.5 billion). The total capacity will be set up within 7 years, by 2011. Under this MOU, the Company would set up an integrated steel plant and the State Government would provide necessary assistance for implementation of the project. The proposed project in Orissa will be vital for the development of that State. It will provide gainful employment to about 2,500 persons directly and about 10,000 persons indirectly in this backward district of the State of Orissa and will also help in the industrial development of the State.

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. has informed the Exchange that Jindal Power Limited (JPL), promoted by Jindal Steel & Power Limited (JSPL) is setting up 1000MW Power Project in Raigarh in the state of Chhattisgarh. Jindal Power Limited has informed that they have finalised orders on Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) for supply, erection and commissioning of Boiler- Turbine Generator Packages (BTGP) in respect of total 1000MW Power Project. In this connection JPL has paid an advance of Rs.80.49 crores to BHEL for supply of BTGPs for first 500 MW Power Project. Advance for second 500MW Power Project will be released to BHEL shortly. First 500MW Power Project will be completed by October, 2007.

Jindal Steel & Power Ltd. had informed the Exchange that the BoD's of the company had, among others, decided to set up 4 Rotary Kilns with an aggregate capacity of 6,60,000 MTPA of Sponge Iron (4 Nos. Rotary Kiln X 165000 MTPA) and 50 MW (2X25 MW) Power Projects at Raigarh in the state of Chhattisgarh. The Company have now informed that one rotary kiln with 165000 MTPA has commenced operation on September 30, 2004, six months ahead of the schedule. This Kiln was scheduled to be completed in March '2005. Other three kilns of sponge iron are likely to be completed sequentially within next four months. One unit of 25 MW Power Plant has also commenced operation along with sponge iron kiln, six months ahead of the schedule. The plant was scheduled to be completed in March '2005. Another power plant of 25MW is likely to be completed by December '04.

Clarification of News : The press had reports that Jindal Steel & Power Limited is planning a bonus for investors.  The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the press and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company. Jindal Steel & Power Limited has vide its letter inter-alia stated, "The Board of Directors of the Company has not so far, decided on the issue of bonus shares."
